Interface IPositionFunction

Namespace: ChargerAstronomyEngine.CosineKittyAstronomy
Assembly: ChargerAstronomyEngine.dll

A function for which to solve a light-travel time problem.

public interface IPositionFunction

Remarks

The function #Astronomy.CorrectLightTravel solves a generalized problem of deducing how far in the past light must have left a target object to be seen by an observer at a specified time. This interface expresses an arbitrary position vector as function of time that is passed to #Astronomy.CorrectLightTravel.
